_comment: IronPal exercise ontology. Every gym-session label must resolve to one id here. Tier 1 entries have hand-authored IronPal fields (head_motion_class, egocentric_visibility, rep_signal) grounded in docs/video-analysis-kb/cases/. Tier 2 entries are heuristically inferred and carry needs_review=true -- confirm before training on them. Rebuild: python3 scripts/kb/build_ontology.py --fetch

sources.name: wger
sources.role: coverage cross-check only -- NOT copied, to keep this ontology free of share-alike obligations

_rig_coupling_warning: egocentric_visibility -- and therefore rep_signal, which depends on the implement actually being in frame -- is PARTLY A PROPERTY OF THE CAPTURE RIG'S FIELD OF VIEW, not purely of the exercise. These verdicts were authored against the POC rig (ELP 4K fisheye, 180-degree mount). A narrower production camera can push a 'visible' exercise to 'partial'/'occluded' and degrade its rep_signal toward 'hard'. Before trusting these fields on new hardware, either spec its FOV >= the POC usable image circle, or re-audit all 37 Tier-1 verdicts. See docs/ironpal-poc-to-production-transfer.md.

coverage_vs_wger.method: substring containment, English names only; rough lead not a precise metric

exercises.notes: Bar sits behind the neck, outside the FOV -- depth is read from floor distance, not the bar.
Supine with the head fixed on the bench -- the head IMU sees almost nothing.
Torso is held static in the hinge, so head motion is near zero despite a large bar excursion.
Case 002 ground truth. Supinated grip is what separates this from an upright row.
Bar travels floor->hip inside the FOV; case 002 confirmed the trajectory is the discriminator.
Bar passes the face and the torso extends -- both channels carry partial signal.
Cases 001 and 007. Alternating vs simultaneous halves/doubles the looming count -- record which.

exercises.source_match: one arm flat bench dumbbell flye

exercises.notes: Implement stays small and at arm's length -- the proximity cue that separates raises from curls.
Implement arcs directly over the face -- unusually clean egocentric visibility.

exercises.source_match: barbell incline bench press medium grip

exercises.notes: Bar descends past the face, giving a large and reliable looming cycle.
No implement -- reps are read from the floor rising and falling.
Legs move below and behind the FOV; expect the same failure mode as case 003.
Whole body translates vertically -- small amplitude but clean IMU periodicity.
Case 003: head still AND the stroke is axial/short -- vision counted 0 of 5 real reps. Trace the cable to the stack; a straight-bar attachment looks exactly like a barbell.
